settings.text: What products should I start with?

Technically, our "supplements" are just food and are beneficial for people (and pets) of all ages! For kiddos, our functional healthcare practitioners recommend one capsule for every 15-20 pounds of body weight.

If you're interested in getting your furry friend started on our nose-to-tail nourishment, our holistic veterinarians recommend one capsule for every 8-12 pounds of bodyweight.

settings.repere: Texte · How much should I take?
Paragraphe · The suggested dose for most of our produ
settings.text:
The suggested dose for most of our products is six capsules per day. We suggest starting at just one capsule per day of each supplement for the first 3-4 days... then, go up to two capsules of each per day for the next 3-4 days... then, three capsules per day... and so on. Until you reach the best therapeutic dose for your unique biology. Yes, this will take some time to reach the suggested dosages but this greatly helps to ensure tolerability of this deep nourishment so that it has a chance to do good.

As you're searching for the ideal dose, you'll really need to pay attention to your body.Try to limit the number of variables that change at any one time. When our customers follow this protocol, it greatly improves tolerability so that this incredible nourishment has the chance to do good. Feel free to go at your own method, but we really want to see you love our products as much as we do... we want you to have more energy...better mood... better vibrancy, health, and happiness.

settings.text: How long does it take to experience benefits?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It really varies in regards to when some
settings.text: It really varies in regards to when someone sees results. Some customers see results the same day and for some, it may take weeks to build up to their optimum dosage. Everyone's biology is different. Most will notice subtle benefits, such as more energy, better mood, improved mental clarity, etc., within the first 2-3 weeks of taking our products. However, for more meaningful benefits, such as those that can be seen as blood markers on a lab test, 2-3 months of consistent use may be necessary.

settings.text: One consideration is that some people experience an energizing effect when they take the Beef Liver or products that contain liver... for this reason, we suggest not taking the Liver or products that contain liver after two or three PM.
